text: Taste and See That Yahweh Is GoodOf David. When he feigned madness before Abimelech, so that he drove him away and he departed.א AlephI will bless Yahweh at all times;His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
ב BethMy soul will make its boast in Yahweh;The humble will hear it and rejoice.
ג GimelO magnify Yahweh with me,And let us exalt His name together.
ד DalethI inquired of Yahweh, and He answered me,And delivered me from all that I dread.ה He - ו Vav
They looked to Him and were radiant,And their faces will never be humiliated.
ז ZayinThis poor man called out, and Yahweh heard himAnd saved him out of all his troubles.
ח HethThe angel of Yahweh encamps around those who fear Him,And rescues them.
ט TethO taste and see that Yahweh is good;How blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
י YodhOh, fear Yahweh, you His saints;For there is no want to those who fear Him.
כ KaphThe young lions do lack and suffer hunger;But they who inquire of Yahweh shall not be in want of any good thing.
ל LamedhCome, you children, listen to me;I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
מ MemWho is the man who delights in lifeAnd loves many days that he may see good?
נ NunGuard your tongue from evilAnd your lips from speaking deceit.
ס SamekhDepart from evil and do good;Seek peace and pursue it.
ע AyinThe eyes of Yahweh are toward the righteousAnd His ears are open to their cry for help.
פ PeThe face of Yahweh is against evildoers,To cut off the memory of them from the earth.
צ TsadheThe righteous cry, and Yahweh hearsAnd delivers them out of all their troubles.
ק QophYahweh is near to the brokenheartedAnd saves those who are crushed in spirit.
ר ReshMany are the evils against the righteous,But Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
שׁ ShinHe keeps all his bones,Not one of them is broken.
ת TavEvil shall slay the wicked,And those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
Yahweh redeems the soul of His slaves,And all those who take refuge in Him will not be condemned.
